stops.title: Wetin na Kapabiliti
stops.caption: Wetin wan grant de gi fɔ tru.
stops.speech: Wan grant na bɔndul fɔ kapabiliti. Wan kapabiliti na di wan tin we i alaw yu fɔ du, lɛk rid wan branch ɔ rayt to wan dipatmɛnt.

stops.title: Usay dɛn de Wok
stops.caption: Ɛvri pej de chɛk dɛn.
stops.speech: Ɛvri pej ɛn ɛvri akshɔn de chɛk wan kapabiliti, na dat mek tu pɔsin wit difrɛn grant de si difrɛn skrin fɔ tru.
